real_defects.issue: An unquoted thousands separator (buy,1,000,150.00) shifted every later column: read as 1 share at $0 with no error, so a 1,000-share washed loss vanished. Rows with more non-empty fields than the header are now refused with a line error.

An unquoted 1,001.40 debit shifted the Status column to '157.10', and the row was dropped as 'not completed' with only an info note: a $1,001.40 fee missing from the journal. Now an error on that line.

An unquoted 1,842.17 payment parsed as $1.00 with no finding when the file has no currency column (with one, the only sign was a confusing 'No 842.17-to-GBP rate'). Found by the new check_column_shift.py on its first run. Now an error on that line.
